blocks.content: Open the watcher you created and review what it checked, what it found, and what state it carried forward. **Overview** shows recent runs. **Standing state** on the right shows the latest assessment and cadence.
To review results, complete the following steps:

blocks.title: Open the watcher and a run

blocks.hint: Skip if you are already on the Watchers list or a watcher detail page.

Skip if you are already on **Overview**. Recent runs are on this tab. If a run failed, check that you still have access to the selected data sources, and recalibrate if queries reference labels that no longer exist.

blocks.content: Confirm the latest assessment in **Standing state**, next to **Run now**.

Open a recent run and read its report and telemetry evidence.

The report explains why the watcher chose **All clear**, **Flagged**, or **Escalated**.

You reviewed the watcher's assessment and, when a run exists, the report and evidence behind it.

Watcher runs consume Assistant tokens, and a monthly usage meter caps how much Watchers can run. If the limit is reached, runs are blocked until the reset date shown on the watcher page.
In the next milestone, you'll wrap up this path and see where to go next.
